items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Like Mab (Harold Mabeern) can play, and Walter Bishop can play.

ctx.x: Oh, all them piano players I know sound pretty good. Like Mab (Harold Mabeern) can play, and Walter Bishop can play. So can Barry Harris, and Tommy Flanagan can play. And what's this other guy? I have his name. But man, all the piano players seem to be able to take care of business.
They tell me Philly Joe is also playing, too. I haven't heard him and his band. I hear he has a good band.
